footnotes: The filing reports no separate capital expenditures, so free cash flow equals operating cash flow.

Figures are from the company's Form 20-F for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue fell 12.8% to $498M in 2025. Operating income rose 6.8% to $225M, a 45.1% margin.
Net income rose 16.4% to $211M, or $1.31 per share. Operating cash flow was $277M and free cash flow $277M, versus $299M; DHT returned $119M through dividends.
sources: DHT Holdings, Inc. Form 20-F for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
